title: Result of spec-kitty feedback --agent-submit | --agent-choice (--json)
description: Invocations: (1) `spec-kitty feedback --agent-submit --trigger <t> --agent <key> --rating <1-5> [--comment <text>] [--email <addr>] --consent yes --json`; (2) `spec-kitty feedback --agent-choice skip|never --trigger <t> --json`. Without `--consent yes`, --agent-submit sends nothing and returns status 'not_sent'. The result never reports delivery success or failure: sending is fire-and-forget.

status.description: handed_off: payload passed to the detached sender. not_sent: consent missing or declined. skipped: user chose skip. prompts_off: user chose 'don't ask again'. invalid_input: rating/email/comment failed validation (nothing sent). no_endpoint: dormant.

message.description: Short text the agent may show the user, e.g. 'Thanks for your feedback.'

errors.description: comment_truncated is informational and accompanies handed_off.
